campaigns.name: BP · Custom Kitchens — SKAG
campaigns.rationale: The ONLY converting pattern in the account. Every SKAG points at the custom kitchen funnel and converts on lead form submission -- the one conversion action still firing (18/30d). Measurable today without waiting on the purchase pixel.

skags.note: Highest purchase intent in the entire dataset -- 'near me' plus category
Highest bid range in the set -- expensive but signals high order value

campaigns.name: BP · Shopping — Brand/Model
campaigns.rationale: Owns ALL product-specific traffic per Trevor's direction. Destination URLs come from the feed, so every click lands on a product page. Budget raised from $35 now that it absorbs the brand/product intent formerly handled by Search.

campaigns.name: BP · PMax — Retail Feed
campaigns.rationale: Second product channel. Feed-driven, so product ads route to product pages automatically. 4 asset groups covering 778 of 894 eligible SKUs.

campaigns.name: BP RT · Display Remarketing
campaigns.rationale: RETAINED. Best CPA in the account -- 7 conversions at $21 on $147/mo, budget-starved at $5/day.

required_negatives.note: Campaign-level negatives beyond the shared universal list, driven by what the keyword data exposed.

BP \u00b7 Grills by Brand \u2014 SKAG.reason: Restaurant chain surfacing in grill searches

landing_page_policy.model: PMax + Shopping -> product pages (from feed). Search -> custom kitchen funnel. Retargeting -> retained. Nothing points at collections.
landing_page_policy.funnel_url_source: VERIFIED — live final URL on 'Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen Campaign', the account's only converting campaign.
landing_page_policy.evidence_collections_dont_convert: 3 enabled Search campaigns point exclusively at collection pages and produced ZERO conversions on $834.81/mo combined: BP S1 Categories Search ($231.15), BP S2 Brands Search ($441.37), BP S3 Brands Expansion ($162.29).
landing_page_policy.dropped_grill_skags: blaze grill / bull grill / fire magic grill / coyote gas grill removed from Search. They are product-specific intent, which Shopping and PMax now own with real product listings. Keeping them in Search would compete with our own Shopping ads on the same queries.
